skill.name: nano-banana-blockrun
skill.description: Generate images through BlockRun's x402 payment gateway using Nano Banana and other supported models. It includes setup guidance and a Python script for paid prompt-based generation.
skill.summary: Generate paid AI images with BlockRun x402 micropayments and supported image models.
skill.author: BlockRunAI

security_audit.summary: Confirmed findings center on wallet private-key handling, broad .env loading, external paid network generation, and local image file writes. Markdown code-fence findings were false positives, and the bundled PNG was manually reviewed as benign. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed text files.

remediation.suggestion: Avoid storing raw private keys in .env files. Prefer a low-balance dedicated wallet, hardware-backed signing, or an explicit external wallet approval flow.
Load configuration only from an explicit trusted path. Do not load .env from the output directory or arbitrary current working directories.
Pin blockrun-llm to a reviewed version and document package integrity checks before users run payment-related code.
Show the model, estimated price, destination service, and wallet address before each generation. Require explicit user confirmation for paid calls.
Validate the output directory, avoid overwriting existing files, and report the exact saved path after generation.

semantic_findings.title: User-Selected Directory Controls Wallet Configuration
semantic_findings.description: The script lets output_dir come from arguments or OUTPUT_DIR, then loads .env from that directory before reading BLOCKRUN_WALLET_KEY. A prompt or wrapper that changes the output path could change which wallet key is used.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code path is direct: output_dir is selected on line 21, .env is loaded from it on line 24, and the wallet key is read on line 29.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned Package Installation From PyPI
semantic_findings.description: Setup instructions install blockrun-llm without a pinned version or hash. This increases supply-chain risk because the package handles wallet signing material.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both setup sections show an unversioned pip install command, and the runtime passes a private key into the installed SDK.

semantic_findings.title: Paid Generation Can Spend User Funds Without Script Confirmation
semantic_findings.description: The skill presents image generation as an automatic action and the script calls client.generate directly. It does not show a local confirmation step with model price before making a paid request.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation describes pay-per-request usage and the script invokes generation after printing the selected model, with no explicit confirmation gate.

content.user_title: Generate Paid AI Images with BlockRun
content.value_statement: Image generation often needs separate API keys and billing setup. This skill uses BlockRun x402 payments to generate images from prompts with supported models.
actual_capabilities: Guides installation of the blockrun-llm Python SDK.
Generates images from text prompts through BlockRun supported models.
Supports Nano Banana, Nano Banana Pro, and DALL-E 3 model names.
Uses a wallet key from environment configuration for x402 payments.
Saves returned base64 PNG images to a chosen output directory.
limitations: Requires USDC on the Base network for each paid image request.
Requires careful handling of a wallet private key or environment variable.
Depends on the external BlockRun API and the blockrun-llm package.
Does not include built-in cost approval before the script sends a request.

use_cases.title: Create Design Concepts
use_cases.description: Generate quick visual concepts for mood boards, landing pages, and creative exploration.

use_cases.title: Produce Project Assets
use_cases.description: Create simple illustrative assets while working inside Claude Code or Codex.

use_cases.title: Test x402 Workflows
use_cases.description: Verify paid AI requests with USDC micropayments on Base using a practical image task.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Image
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for one generated image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an image of a quiet desk with a notebook, a coffee cup, and soft morning light.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Higher Quality Model
prompt_templates.scenario: Request a specific model for a detailed concept.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a detailed concept image of a compact electric camper van. Use Nano Banana Pro if available.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Product Visual
prompt_templates.scenario: Ask for a practical marketing asset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a clean product hero image for a privacy-focused notes app. Use a calm office setting and no visible text.

prompt_templates.title: Report Generation Details
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt that asks for output tracking.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an image of a futuristic transit station. Before running it, state the model, estimated cost, output folder, and wallet address.

output_examples.input: Generate an image of a sunset over mountains.
output_examples.output: The skill generates the image through BlockRun and returns either a hosted image URL or a saved PNG path.

output_examples.input: Create a high-quality image of a modern kitchen for a design pitch.
output_examples.output: The skill selects a supported model, sends the prompt for paid generation, and reports any revised prompt returned by the provider.

output_examples.input: Save the generated image to my project assets folder.
output_examples.output: The script writes the returned PNG image to the requested output directory and prints the final file location.

best_practices: Use a dedicated wallet with a small USDC balance for image generation.
Review prompts before sending sensitive or private information to BlockRun.
Confirm the model, estimated price, and output directory before repeated runs.
anti_patterns: Do not place a primary wallet private key in a project .env file.
Do not run repeated generations without monitoring wallet balance and cost.
Do not send confidential, regulated, or customer data in image prompts.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps Claude, Codex, or Claude Code generate images through BlockRun supported image models.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: No API key is described. The workflow uses x402 payments with USDC on the Base network.

faq.question: What payment method does it use?
faq.answer: It uses USDC micropayments on Base for each generated image request.

faq.question: Where are generated images saved?
faq.answer: Base64 PNG results are saved to the selected output directory. Other image results may be printed as URLs.

faq.question: Does my wallet key leave my machine?
faq.answer: The documentation says signing is local. Users should still treat the key as sensitive and use a limited wallet.

faq.question: Is automatic installation recommended?
faq.answer: Manual review is recommended because the skill handles wallet keys, installs a package, makes network calls, and spends funds.
